api: new wapmorgan\Mp3Info\Mp3Info(local temporary file path) -> codecVersion, layerVersion, sampleRate, channel, bitRate, isVbr, audioSize, _framesCount, duration
coverage: Xdebug executed line coverage in wapmorgan/mp3info; src/Mp3Info.php holds the MPEG frame-header reader
coverage_limit: MPEG-1 Layer III CBR only. With the documented constructor and default settings ($framesCountRead = 2), Mp3Info reads the first frame header, jumps by a computed frame length to read a second header, estimates frames as ceil(audio bytes / frame length) and reports duration as (frames - 1) x 1152 / sample rate, so the MPEG-1 control's duration is one frame (0.02612 s) below the 11-frame oracle. It does not decode audio or walk every frame. On the MPEG-2 22.05 kHz stereo control it uses the MPEG-1 144-byte coefficient for frame length, skips the real third frame, and takes a false sync inside audio data at byte 236; it reports MPEG-2 Layer II, 24 kHz mono, 96 kbit/s and 3 frames. MPEG-2 and MPEG-2.5 are therefore not covered. VBR, Xing/Info, free-format, Layer I/II and tagged inputs are untested here; ID3v2 scope is the separate mp3_id3v2/php record.
